description: Create an organization-level label. Returns the created label including its numeric id.

exclusive.description: Exclusive: marks this label's scope (the name before the last /, e.g. status in status/ready) as exclusive. A write that names two labels from one exclusive scope is refused; a label the issue already carries is not counted, so an issue can still end up with two. Default false. No effect on a name without a /.

name: create_org_label
